RAVEE MEHTA

Managing Director
Prior to founding Nishkama Capital, from October of 2002 to October of 2010, Mr. Mehta worked at Karsch Capital Management LLC as a Managing Director, where he was responsible for investments in the technology and telecommunications sectors. From August of 1999 to September of 2002, Mr. Mehta worked at Soros Fund Management LLC. Mr. Mehta worked initially as a private equity associate and subsequently as an analyst in the technology sector during his tenure at Soros. Mr. Mehta started his career as an Investment Banking Analyst at Donaldson, Lufkin & Jenrette, Inc. after graduating summa cum laude from The University of Pennsylvania with BSE degrees from both The Wharton School of Business and The School of Engineering and Applied Science. Mr. Mehta is the author of The Emotionally Intelligent Investor: How Self Awareness, Empathy and Intuition Drive Performance, which was published in August of 2012.
